name: inspect
description: See workbook structure and live formulas before changing anything

tools.name: inspect_workbook
tools.description: List sheets and Excel Tables with used range, headers, and row counts. Call this first. Does not dump all cell values.

tools.name: inspect_table
tools.description: Inspect one Excel Table: headers, columns (0-based index + letter A/B/…), data row count, up to 5 sample rows. For 取数_* sheets may include likelyHeaderless and reshapeHint — use reshape_table op=project with headerless:true, not read_range.

tools.name: inspect_formulas
tools.description: Read formulas AND cached values for a Table or range. Returns counts (inputs/formulas/cross-sheet/errors), up to 40 error cells, and a small formula sample. Does not dump the whole grid. Prefer this before editing formulas.

tableName.description: Excel Table name. If set, sheetName/range are ignored.

range.description: A1 range. Omit to use the sheet used range.

tools.name: scan_formula_errors
tools.description: Scan the workbook (or one sheet) for Excel error values: #REF! #DIV/0! #N/A #NAME? #VALUE! #NUM! and similar. Read-only. Returns up to 40 hits with address, formula, and displayed value.

sheetName.description: Optional. Omit to scan every sheet.
